about: Single source of the pet shop's operations. Cited by every unit under petshop/; read by the measures and by the desk.

protocol.call: <work>/run do <operation>  -- one JSON object on stdin, one JSON object on stdout
protocol.failure: {"ok": false, "error": "<code>"} and exit status not 0; nothing is changed
protocol.PETSHOP_DATA: directory given to the unit; the only place it writes; created if absent; what is stored survives between calls
protocol.PETSHOP_PEER: executable with this same protocol, through which a unit calls the operations it receives from other units
protocol.types: int: JSON integer; text: JSON string; id: positive int chosen by the owner; date: YYYY-MM-DD; minute: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, a real date and time
protocol.errors everywhere: unknown_operation; missing_field (a required field absent or empty text); invalid (wrong type or a value the operation forbids); not_found (an id that does not exist)

customer.find.rule: every customer whose name or phone contains the text, ignoring case

product.add.rule: price_cents and stock are not negative

stock.receive.rule: quantity is at least 1; returns the stock after

stock.take.rule: quantity is at least 1; error insufficient_stock when it exceeds the stock, which then stays as it was

appointment.book.rule: service is bath or grooming; error taken when the same pet already has a booked appointment at that start

appointment.cancel.rule: a cancelled appointment leaves the day and frees its start

appointment.day.rule: the booked appointments of that date, ordered by start

sale.make.rule: at least one item, each quantity at least 1; takes the stock of every item; on any error (not_found for a product or the customer, insufficient_stock) no stock is left changed and no sale exists; no payment is taken, only recorded

sale.void.rule: gives the stock of every item back and marks the sale voided; error invalid when it is already voided

desk.call: <work>/run serve  -- serves staff on http://127.0.0.1:$PETSHOP_PORT until killed; performs every operation through PETSHOP_PEER and keeps no data of its own
desk.GET /: 200, HTML with a link href="/<operation>" for every operation
desk.GET /<operation>: 200, HTML with a form method="post" holding a control name="<field>" for every field; for a field that is a list of objects, name="<field>.<key>" for every key, which may repeat
desk.POST /<operation>: form-encoded. Text becomes the contract's type; an empty field that is not required is left out; repeated <field>.<key> become the list, in order. Success: 200 and every text and number of the result is in the page. Failure: 400 and the error code is in the page. A value that is not of its type: 400 with invalid, and the peer is not called.
